name: Spannerly
summary: A car and bike parts shop: a night-drive hero, parts finder, deal countdown, bag and checkout
about: A one-page landing page and full shop for car and bike parts. The hero is a night drive with a parallax skyline, spinning wheels and a rev gauge, and each section below animates in: a parts finder that scans your vehicle, departments, a deal countdown, best sellers, a delivery road and reviews. Behind it are a filterable listing, product pages with colour and size pickers, a working bag in PKR with promo codes and a validated checkout. Good for an auto parts store, a tyre and wheel shop or any shop with a big catalogue.
how: The car drives into the hero, the rev gauge sweeps and the headline skids in word by word.
Use the parts finder: pick Car or Bike, your vehicle and a part, then press Find parts to scan and jump to matching parts.
In Shop, filter by department, vehicle, colour, size, price or sale, search by name and change the sort.
On a product, choose a colour (the picture repaints), a size and a quantity, then Add to bag: the part flies into the bag.
In the bag, change quantities, remove lines, and try the codes PITSTOP10 or FREETOW to see the totals roll.
Checkout validates your details, runs through stock and rider checks, then celebrates with confetti and a tracking line.
